items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: Who was in the Blue Parody? ... A boy by the name of S.J. Coogan ... I was on guitar

ctx.x: Who was in the Blue Parody?

Oh, I can't remember all the fellas. Well, Angelo was on trumpet. He was the band leader. A fellow on drums was a CPA nowadays. Phillip Quaglina was on trombone. Joe Quaglina was on third alto or first alto. I don't recall which one. A boy by the name of S.J. Coogan who worked for the federal government many years later. He was on saxophone, probably tenor sax I guess. Maybe he played lead alto. S.J. Coogan played lead alto. Joe Quaglina probably played lead a third, I don't recall which. And I can't remember.…
Yeah, and you had, did he have one or two trumpets? What did they have?
